title: AHB Assertion, Coverage, and Formal Rigor Model
description: Execute accepted-phase assertion triggers, configuration-derived coverage legality, reset cancellation, formal assumptions/covers, vacuity review, and bounded product-service contracts.
learnerQuestion: What evidence proves an AHB property was triggered, non-vacuous, configuration-valid, and reviewed?

configurations.label: AHB5 single-manager
configurations.description: RETRY and SPLIT bins are illegal; ERROR and OKAY are legal.

configurations.label: Original shared AHB
configurations.description: RETRY and SPLIT are legal with revision-specific arbiter state.

scenarios.label: Accepted trigger and bounded service
scenarios.description: The protocol trigger is accepted transfer state; the four-cycle completion bound is a declared product contract.

checks.label: Held address does not retrigger
checks.evidence: Properties sample accepted phases, not every clock of a held request.

checks.label: Exactly one obligation
checks.evidence: The antecedent becomes non-vacuous on the accepted request.

checks.label: Antecedent exercised
checks.evidence: Cover evidence proves the assertion did not pass only because its trigger was absent.

steps.label: Complete
steps.event: Following data phase completes at age 3

checks.label: Configured service bound
checks.evidence: The bounded completion result is reported separately from universal protocol safety.

scenarios.label: Reset cancellation
scenarios.description: Reset cancels the local proof obligation; reset assumptions and post-reset covers remain explicit.

checks.label: Disable-iff cancellation
checks.evidence: Reset behavior is modeled rather than counted as a completion or timeout.

checks.label: Post-reset behavior reachable
checks.evidence: A cover prevents a reset assumption from making the proof vacuous.

scenarios.label: Configuration-derived bins
scenarios.description: Legal, illegal, and ignore classifications derive from revision and enabled optional properties.

steps.label: Classify bins
steps.event: Build response cross from selected revision

checks.label: RETRY illegal in selected configuration
checks.evidence: The coverage model does not create false holes for a response omitted from AHB5.

checks.label: Accepted-phase coverage exercised
checks.evidence: Accepted and completed events are sampled separately.
